scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Monday’s plated-dessert garnish practical usable if the station assignment requires live pulled-sugar handling.
Emerging Need: The high-heat sugar glove fit-and-return checkout is not logged, but it matters only once the unsettled garnish format becomes a learner-handled pulled-sugar station.
Decision Context: Stored records identify the missing checkout and the rule limiting reservations to confirmed live-sugar assignments; live notices establish the future practical, verified desk route, station assignment, and posting window.
Consequence: Timely prerequisite handling preserves participation in the future station, while the desk batch seal leaves no checkout posting route before roster precheck.
